description: Every registered stock built-in scalar and array exposes PostgreSQL 18 pg_type metadata
sql: WITH supported AS (SELECT oid, typarray FROM pg_type WHERE typname IN ('bool','bytea','char','name','int8','int2','int2vector','int4','regproc','text','oid','tid','xid','cid','oidvector','json','xml','cidr','float4','float8','macaddr8','money','macaddr','inet','varchar','bpchar','date','time','timestamp','timestamptz','interval','timetz','numeric','bit','varbit','refcursor','regprocedure','xid8','regclass','regtype','pg_ddl_command','table_am_handler','index_am_handler','unknown','record','cstring','any','anyarray','anyelement','anynonarray','void','trigger','language_handler','internal','fdw_handler','tsm_handler','anyenum','anyrange','event_trigger','anymultirange','anycompatiblemultirange','anycompatible','anycompatiblearray','anycompatiblenonarray','anycompatiblerange','uuid','tsvector','tsquery','regconfig','regdictionary','jsonb','jsonpath','int4range','numrange','tsrange','tstzrange','daterange','int8range','regnamespace','point','lseg','path','box','polygon','line','circle','regoper','regoperator','txid_snapshot','pg_lsn','regrole','regcollation','int4multirange','nummultirange','tsmultirange','tstzmultirange','datemultirange','int8multirange','pg_snapshot')) SELECT typname::text, oid::bigint, typnamespace::bigint, typowner::bigint, typlen::integer, typbyval, typtype::text, typcategory::text, typispreferred, typisdefined, typdelim::text, typrelid::bigint, typsubscript::text, typelem::bigint, typarray::bigint, typinput::text, typoutput::text, typreceive::text, typsend::text, typmodin::text, typmodout::text, typanalyze::text, typalign::text, typstorage::text, typnotnull, typbasetype::bigint, typtypmod, typndims, typcollation::bigint, typdefaultbin::text, typdefault, typacl::text FROM pg_type WHERE oid IN (SELECT oid FROM supported) OR oid IN (SELECT typarray FROM supported WHERE typarray <> 0) ORDER BY oid;
